4  THESE WRIT PETITIONS COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER Sri.Ravi V.Hosamani, the learned AGA is directed to take notice for respondent Nos.1 to 3.
Notice to respondent No.4 is dispensed with.

2. Heard.
3.
The petitioners have installed in all 15 community drinking water unit in Siruguppa town.

The 2 n d respondent issued notice Annexures-B1 to B14 to the petitioners on 04 t h October 2017 alleging that the petitioners are running the said water unit for the purpose of consumption of the public without quality standard certification as required under Regulation No.2.3.14(17)(18) of Food Safety and Standards (Prohibition and Restriction on Sales) Regulations, 2011 and the petitioners have to show cause as to why the said Unit shall not be seized and action under Section 63 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 shall not be taken.

entities.text: Food Safety and Standards (Prohibition and Restriction on Sales) Regulations, 2011
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 4. The petitioner and others have submitted their reply Annexures-F, F1 to F10 to the said notices contending that they are serving only unpacked drinking water and they are running those units for the benefit of the public at large as a service.
5. The petitioners contend that the second respondent without considering their objections and passing any orders on such objection is proposing to seize the said water purifier units.
6. When the second respondent has issued show cause notices as aforesaid, he is bound to consider those objections before taking any action in the matter.
Without considering those objections, the respondents cannot proceed to take any further action in the matter.
Therefore, the petitions are allowed.
7. The 2 n d respondent is directed to consider the objections of the petitioners wherever filed.
The other petitioners whoever have not filed the objections shall file their objections within twelve days from the date of receipt of copy of this order.

The 2nd respondent shall consider all those objections,
after affording an opportunity of hearing to the petitioners and pass orders in accordance with law.

Sd/-
